Home / Services / Engine Replacement
Service · replacement

Engine Replacement

When an engine has failed outright, replacement is usually faster and cheaper than chasing the fault. We supply the reconditioned engine and carry your original accessories across onto it.

Call (03) 8900 6005
Carried out at Hallam 40+ years hands-on Talk to the workshop

Where this is carried out

All hands-on engine work happens at 3 David Lee Rd, Hallam, Victoria. Interstate customers are supplied the reconditioned engine and arrange fitting with a mechanic near them. We do not have a workshop in any other state.

What it involves

How we approach it

Done by engine specialists

Hyundai and Kia engines are close to all we work on, which is why we can match codes across build years without guessing.

Tested before release

Any engine we release has been checked for output, torque and fuel efficiency.

A price you can compare

Engine prices are published with GST included and fitting is a flat $1,000. Send an itemised written quote and we will beat it by five per cent.

How it works

Four steps

Tell us the vehicle

Rego or VIN, and what it is doing. That is enough for us to work out what is needed.

We confirm the work and price

What the job involves and what it costs, before you commit.

Booked in at Hallam

Bring it in, or ask about towing and collection if it cannot be driven.

Back on the road

Checked before it goes back to you, and you deal with the workshop afterwards, not a reseller.

Questions

Common questions

Do you offer this outside Victoria?

The hands-on work is carried out at our Hallam workshop only. Interstate we supply the reconditioned engine and your own mechanic does the installation.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the engine and the vehicle. Engine prices are published with GST included and fitting is a flat $1,000. Send your rego or VIN for the figure for your vehicle.

How long will it take?

We give a realistic window when we confirm the booking rather than an optimistic one. If the vehicle is earning, say so and we will tell you what is possible.

Will you beat another quote?

Yes, by five per cent, on an itemised written quote for identical work from a legitimate workshop.
